title: The Final Machine
author: Sable Ravensworth
blurb: Theo Lockridge, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
